content: Provide the diagnostic status information according to ISO 14229-1 Description: The diagnostic in AUTOSAR shall provide the diagnostic status information according to the DTCStatusMask, ISO 14229-1 v.2013 (refer to DTC status mask), Annex D5 Rationale: Advanced fault analysis Use Case: Improved fault and event tracking and analysis AppliesTo: CP, AP Dependencies: – Supporting Material: ISO 14229-1 v.2013
